name: mongtro-server
description: Run Mongtro backend + frontend with one command

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:
node -e "console.log('
[server] Dashboard (Vite, live reload): http://127.0.0.1:5173
[server] If that fails, check the [web] line below for another port (e.g. 5174).
[server] API: http://127.0.0.1:6291 - use :5173 for the UI during dev.
')" && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
